question:
If $n(A) = m$, $n(B) = n$ then write the

(a) Number of functions from $A$ to $B$.

(b) Number of relation from $A$ to $A$.
explanation:
(a) Each element of $A$ can map to any of the $n$ elements of $B$. Hence number of functions from $A$ to $B$ is $n^m$.

(b) Number of ordered pairs in $A \times A$ is $m^2$. Each pair may or may not belong to the relation. Hence number of relations from $A$ to $A$ is $2^{m^2}$.
